anomaly: im-connect 层消息上抛失败: UpstreamProducer send failed topic=client2server

ground_truth.root_cause: RocketMQ broker 宕机(10911 端口不可达,connect 进程 SYN_SENT 重连),im-connect 的 UpstreamProducer 发送 client2server 消息失败,消息无法上抛到 im-chat,MessageDispatcher 记录 upstream send failed
ground_truth.solution: 恢复 RocketMQ broker(重启 mqbroker 并检查 namesrv 路由与磁盘空间)
